pi-cmrgj8ifd000i01qrtrq9002o.description: This document would answer questions about the coverage and benefits of the 'Jeevan Shagun (With Profits)' plan, such as what conditions must be met for benefit payouts, what statutory terms and definitions apply, and what data is included in the policy schedule. It would also provide information on the claims process, including the legal framework and administrative contact details. Additionally, users can find answers to questions about policyholder and nominee data, as well as plan-related details.

pi-cmrgj8jsv000j01qr7tefecxu.description: This document answers questions about the roles of individuals involved in an insurance policy, such as the policyholder, nominee, and assignee, as well as technical policy parameters like commencement date, maturity, premiums, and surrender value. It also provides information on administrative procedures, including proposal forms, free-look periods, policy amendments, and valuation. Additionally, users can find answers to questions about regulatory frameworks, including the IRDA and the Insurance Act 1938.

pi-cmrgj8o7x000k01qr3dw0m60w.description: This document answers questions about coverage types, such as the calculation of Death Benefits under various premium modes and options, and the availability of Accident Benefit Riders. It also provides information on procedures, including premium payments, grace periods, proof of age requirements, policy forfeiture, and the revival of lapsed policies. Additionally, it covers rules and limits, such as the 30-day free look period, surrender value calculations, and the option for the Life Assured to receive death benefits in installments.

pi-cmrgj8qzp000l01qrz5eezgxg.description: This document answers questions about accidental death benefit coverage, such as what benefits are payable in the event of an accidental death, the rules for cancellation and reinstatement of the benefit, and the exclusions that may prevent payment of the benefit, including specific circumstances like suicide, substance abuse, and war-related events. Users can also find information on the procedures for claiming the accidental death benefit, including the requirements for payment and the timeframe for making a claim. Additionally, the document provides details on the limits of the benefit, including the sum assured and the conditions under which it will be paid.

pi-cmrgj8ulw000m01qroweet8jf.description: This document answers questions about the Accident Shield Policy, including what is covered under Accidental Death and Disability, Permanent Partial Disability, and the Education Benefit, as well as policy exclusions, limitations, and rules. It also provides information on policy definitions, coverage sections, and general terms and clauses, including premium payment structures, claim filing requirements, and grievance redressal procedures. Additionally, it outlines the scope of coverage, 24-hour protection, and the prohibition of rebates under the Insurance Act, 1938.

pi-cmrgj8xws000n01qry913n8s2.description: This document answers specific questions about the Accident Super Guard Plus insurance policy, including coverage types, procedures, limits, and rules. Users can ask about the scope and conditions for Base Benefits (Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability) and Optional Benefits (Permanent Partial Disability), as well as the criteria for claims, payment calculations, exclusions, and the automatic cessation of coverage upon reaching the maximum Sum Insured. Additionally, users can inquire about the coverage for out-patient medical expenses arising from Road Traffic Accidents, in-patient hospitalisation expenses for accidental injuries, and the specific definitions, claim conditions, payment limitations, and exclusions for each benefit type.

pi-cmrgj90gz000o01qrdqxly7m6.description: This document answers specific questions about the Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, including what types of medical expenses are covered, such as hospitalization, AYUSH treatment, cataract treatment, and pre- and post-hospitalization expenses. It also provides information on coverage limits, sublimits, and rules for Cumulative Bonus accrual and reduction, as well as policy exclusions, claim procedures, and administrative provisions. Additionally, it outlines the terms for instalment-based premium payments, policy revisions, and grievance redressal processes.
